_note: r13 seo: site identity for tools/seo.py. site_url is the canonical origin used in canonical, og:url, sitemap, robots and llms.txt. Until the domain is live it is the .invalid placeholder (never a real host). Build with SITE_URL=https://<domain> python3 tools/build.py, or set site_url here once the domain is decided; the combined deploy (backend scripts/copy-static.mjs) replaces the placeholder with its SITE_URL env at build time.
name: 101 Codecrafts
slogan: Start at 101. Craft your way up.
og_alt: 101 Codecrafts: Start at 101. Craft your way up.
_noindex_note: Public but kept out of search: auth.html (sign-in form; the sign-in/sign-up URLs redirect to it), product.html and profile.html (templates filled from ?id= / ?u= by script: one URL for every product/person, so no per-item canonical). Index them once they are server-rendered per item.
llms_summary: 101 Codecrafts is a tech learning and collaboration community based in Kampala, Uganda: courses and learning paths, coding practice, projects, hackathons, events, mentorship, daily tech news and opportunities, for learners from Primary school to professionals.
llms_note: Public pages are listed below. Courses, practice, the library, AI tools and the marketplace open after a free sign-in, so they are not listed. Prices are in Uganda shillings (UGX); payments are by MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money or card.
